plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Session-based /handoff and /resume slash commands so Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can hand work off to each other without losing context. Ships a PreCompact hook that blocks context summarization until a fresh handoff exists.

commands.name: handoff
commands.description: Update HANDOFF.<session>.md with current session state so another AI tool can pick up the work
headings: Template (use exactly this structure when creating from scratch)

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Read HANDOFF.<session>.md and continue the work from where the previous AI session left off

headings: Switch to Codex in the same repo
Codex executes the next step, hands back
Back in Claude Code, possibly hours later
